GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

7. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

14. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
